moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins today with Arsenal facing newly-promoted Coventry City, marking the return of top-flight football across the UK.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: Game on! The Premier League is back, and it all kicks off tonight with Arsenal hosting Coventry City. Who are you backing for the first goal of the season?

angles.name: Weekend Fixture Build-up
angles.copy: Your weekend plans are sorted! Premier League action continues with Hull v Man Utd, Newcastle v Liverpool, and more. Get ready for a football frenzy.

moments.title: Women's Rugby World Cup Begins in England
moments.blurb: The Women's Rugby World Cup kicks off tomorrow, August 22nd, in England, featuring teams from around the globe competing for the sport's ultimate prize.

angles.name: Tournament Launch
angles.copy: It's here! The Women's Rugby World Cup starts tomorrow in England. Get ready for incredible action and world-class talent on display.

angles.name: Local Interest - Wales
angles.copy: Huge weekend for Welsh rugby! The Women's Rugby World Cup sees Scotland take on Wales in Manchester on Sunday. Let's go, Cymru!

angles.name: Local Interest - Exeter
angles.copy: Exeter, get ready! The Women's Rugby World Cup is bringing top-tier rugby to Sandy Park this Sunday as Wales face Fiji. Who's heading down to support?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Takes Over Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival returns for the August Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 27-30), with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Reading & Leeds explodes! Who are you most excited to see – Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, or Fontaines D.C.? Let the countdown begin!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Bank Holiday weekend means one thing for music fans: Reading & Leeds! Get ready for four days of unforgettable live music. What's your must-see act?

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Set for Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: Europe's biggest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, returns to West London this August Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 30-31) for a vibrant celebration of Caribbean culture.

angles.name: Carnival Excitement
angles.copy: London, get ready to move! Notting Hill Carnival is just over a week away, bringing incredible music, food, and culture to the streets of West London. Who's going?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Must-Do
angles.copy: Planning your Bank Holiday weekend? Don't miss the iconic Notting Hill Carnival! It's Europe's largest street festival for a reason.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Just over a week until the August Bank Holiday! What are your plans for the long weekend? Making the most of the last blast of summer?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The final Bank Holiday until Christmas is just around the corner on August 31st! Let's make it a memorable one.

moments.title: Happy 38th Birthday, Kacey Musgraves!
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country and pop singer-songwriter Kacey Musgraves turns 38 today, known for hits like 'Golden Hour' and 'Rainbow'.

angles.name: Kacey's Big Day
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Kacey Musgraves, who turns 38 today! Which of her tracks is your favourite to sing along to?

moments.title: Kelis Turns 47 Today!
moments.blurb: R&B and soul icon Kelis, famous for her genre-bending sound and hits like 'Milkshake', celebrates her 47th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Kelis
angles.copy: It's Kelis's 47th birthday! From 'Caught Out There' to 'Milkshake', her tracks are timeless. What's your go-to Kelis tune?

moments.title: The Prodigy's Liam Howlett is 55!
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, the mastermind behind electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Prodigy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Liam Howlett of The Prodigy! His beats changed the game. What's your favourite Prodigy anthem?

moments.title: Dua Lipa Turns 31 Tomorrow!
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday tomorrow, August 22nd, continuing her reign on the charts.

angles.name: Dua's Birthday Eve
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Dua Lipa turns 31 tomorrow. Which of her massive hits will you be spinning to mark the occasion?

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Tori Amos
moments.blurb: Alternative rock icon Tori Amos celebrates her 63rd birthday tomorrow, August 22nd, known for her distinctive piano-driven music.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Tori Amos turns 63! Her music is truly unique. What's your favourite Tori Amos track that still gives you chills?

moments.title: Tears for Fears' Roland Orzabal Turns 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder of the iconic 80s band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday tomorrow, August 22nd.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Shout out to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears, who turns 65 tomorrow! Their music defined a generation. What's your go-to Tears for Fears hit?

moments.title: Gene Simmons Celebrates 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: KISS bassist and co-lead singer Gene Simmons will turn 77 on Monday, August 25th, continuing his legendary rock career.

angles.name: KISS Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: The Demon himself, Gene Simmons of KISS, turns 77 on Monday! What's your favourite KISS track or memory?

moments.title: Elvis Costello Turns 72 on Monday
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for his new wave and rock hits, celebrates his 72nd birthday this Monday, August 25th.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the legendary Elvis Costello on Monday! Which of his brilliant songs is a must-listen for you?

moments.title: Garbage Frontwoman Shirley Manson Turns 60
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic lead singer of alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday next Tuesday, August 26th.

angles.name: 90s Alt Queen
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage turns 60! Her voice defined a generation. What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Valerie Simpson of Ashford & Simpson is 78
moments.blurb: Valerie Simpson, half of the legendary R&B songwriting and performing duo Ashford & Simpson, turns 78 next Tuesday, August 26th.

angles.name: Soul Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the brilliant Valerie Simpson of Ashford & Simpson on Tuesday! Her songs are pure magic. Which one's your favourite?

moments.title: All Points East Underway in London
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival is currently running from August 21-30, bringing a diverse lineup of artists to Victoria Park.

angles.name: East London Festival
angles.copy: All Points East is ON! Victoria Park is buzzing with live music and good vibes all weekend and into next week. Who are you catching in London?

moments.title: Greenwich + Docklands International Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The free Greenwich + Docklands International Festival (GDIF) begins today, August 21st, transforming East London with outdoor theatre, dance, and art until September 6th.

angles.name: Free Festival Fun
angles.copy: Looking for free culture in London? The Greenwich + Docklands International Festival kicks off today with spectacular outdoor performances!

moments.title: England vs Pakistan First Test Concludes
moments.blurb: The First Test Match between England and Pakistan, which began on August 19th, concludes today, August 23rd.

angles.name: Cricket Finale
angles.copy: It's the final day of the First Test between England and Pakistan! Will England secure a victory? Tune in to find out!
